notes.title: Update Notes for March 1
notes.notes:
In this update, we have fixed some overall bugs for this game.

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[h3]Bullets[/h3]
- Bullets now spawn towards the back of the barrel
- This will make shooting zombies that are close easier

[h3]Grabbables[/h3]
- Some objects can now be grabbed. (Only the water bottle for now)
- These will be used in the future for certain things...

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
[h3]Zombies[/h3]
- Animation speed fixes
- Zombie ragdoll velocity should sync better

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 21
notes.notes:
Zombie animations and walk speed have been balanced, and should look more realistic now! The zombie network framework has been redone, which should allow for more consistent gameplay!

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
- Zombies now sync with other clients more efficiently
- Zombie animations have been redone

Please join [url=https://discord.gg/4x4p4VqyeN]this discord[/url] for more information and news about Zombie Slayer!

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 20
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
- 2 new weapons have been added, including a new burst pistol
- Better PC support
- Revive by standing near teammates
- New tutorial map

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
- Voice chat should now work in the lobby

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 14
notes.notes: In this update, we have fixed many of the PC bugs and general connection bugs. Multiplayer should work correctly now!

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 13
notes.notes:
[h1]PC mode![/h1]

Play with your friends even if you don't own a VR headset!

notes.title: Voice Chat Update
notes.notes:
Finally, another game-changing update! 

In this update, we have finally added voice chatting, which was a much-needed feature. We have also finished the first map and we will be focusing on polishing some of the features now, and adding new content, such as perks, weapons, and maps!

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
- Voice chat! You can now talk to your friends in game.
- Sound settings: you can change the volume of music, sound fx, and voice chat now
- Finished the first map

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
- The pink spheres on weapons are no longer visible
- Balanced zombies
- The "random weapon" box now requires power

[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
- Hand animations on weapons will look correct soon
- Voice chat will work in the lobby soon
- Challenge maps

We are now consistently working on this project, so expect updates almost every week. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes: We finally fixed multiplayer. Multiplayer should now be much more consistent than before. We also fixed the hand rotations for multiplayer, and we are working on fixing some minor bugs too. Bullets should now fire in the correct direction for every player now! Also, ragdolls were improved in this update and should react better to physdics.

notes.title: RPG Update
notes.notes:
The RPG has finally been added to this game, and it finally works.
Shoot rockets at zombies, and watch their dead bodies fly across the world.

We are finally starting to consistently work on our game again, so expect regular updates.
